name: Avatar group
summary: Overlapping stack of avatars with a counter for the rest, to show who is involved in something.
use: Team members of a project, people in a conversation.
avoid: When the user needs to choose or compare people: use a list.
anatomy: Avatars with a ring in the background color.
reactProps: Default 4. The rest goes into the counter.
Name of the "+n" avatar. Defaults in DEFAULT_AVATAR_GROUP_LABELS.
a11y: Give the group a label with the total ("6 team members"). The counter alone is not enough.
